rulings.text: The one venue is said with the locative-relative on the fort name, container first: «El-Ahsa Belediye Kalesi'ndeki Geleneksel Füreyc mahallesi» (pattern of E1-venues-r3, «Ukayr Plajı'ndaki park»). Both termbase names («El-Ahsa Belediye Kalesi», «Geleneksel Füreyc mahallesi») stand byte-identical; E1-venues's note that the English does not say whether the fort contains the Freej is superseded by the owner's ruling of 2026-11-05.

blind_disposition.disposition: Goal met: one venue site with the quarter inside the castle.

source_defect. Source defect recorded in tr-events-1: the English name «Municipality Fort» does not say what the place is; both names are kept exactly as the published value writes them. Not this batch.

blind_disposition.item: P2 Geleneksel read as part of the name; mahalle in a castle
blind_disposition.disposition: Out of scope: the capital is the termbase name (E1-venues-r2); a quarter inside the fort is the owner's fact.
Rejected as a syntax fault: «X'ndeki Y» means Y in X in one way only, and the reader reached it; same build as E1-venues-r3, passed by its readers.

positions.current: Geleneksel Füreyc mahallesi, El-Ahsa Belediye Kalesi
positions.proposed: El-Ahsa Belediye Kalesi'ndeki Geleneksel Füreyc mahallesi
